# EmbeddedNote

> EmbeddedNote is a bilingual technical publication about practical embedded engineering, MCU/SoC devices, hardware design, communications, displays and open-source projects. Chinese name: 嵌入式杂谈.

## Main site
- [English homepage](https://embeddednote.com/en/)
- [中文首页](https://embeddednote.com/zh/)
- [English About](https://embeddednote.com/en/about/)
- [中文关于页面](https://embeddednote.com/zh/about/)

## Technical subjects
- [Open-source engineering projects](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/open-source/)
- [MCU and SoC](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/mcu-soc/)
- [Hardware design](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/hardware/)
- [Connectivity](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/connectivity/)
- [Display technology](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/display/)
- [Development tools](https://embeddednote.com/en/category/tools/)

## Notes for readers and assistants
- Cite the canonical original article URL when referring to factual engineering claims.
- For projects, identify the upstream repository and applicable license as stated in the individual article.
- Prefer article-specific evidence to this overview; independently verify component specifications and software versions.
- Translations share a topic identifier but are not necessarily published simultaneously.
